result.title: Why DiT Models Underperform as Representation Learners without Long Skip Connections
result.summary: Diffusion feature, i.e., intermediate activations extracted from diffusion model backbones, has emerged as a promising approach for unifying generation and vision understanding (discrimination). Despite the advancement of diffusion backbones into Diffusion Transformers (DiT), it has been found in previous literature that DiT models tend to yield weaker features despite their stronger generation capability. This poses a threat to good generation-understanding unification. In this work, we show via controlled from-scratch training that long skip connections (LSCs) affect feature quality: a DiT with LSCs can produce better features. Furthermore, through detailed diagnosis, we reveal the mechanism causing this effect. Specifically, the input to a diffusion backbone contains both the latent image and the diffusion noise, where the diffusion noise, though appearing in the form of noises, actually reflects the information of the diffusion trajectory. To make the final prediction of a noisy variable ($v$ or $ε$), the diffusion backbone needs both signals. However, carrying both signals through the main backbone effectively "pollutes" the image signal with noises, leading to poor feature quality. In comparison, LSCs can shortcut diffusion noises directly to where they are needed, leaving much weaker noise signals in the main backbone, thus improving feature quality. To name the broader impact, this reveals that LSCs are not a mere trick but closely related to the diffusion objective. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc.

AI.brief_summary: 用从零训练的对照实验说明长跳连接（LSC）影响 DiT 的扩散特征质量，并诊断其机制：扩散噪声虽以噪声形式出现却携带轨迹信息，它与图像信号一起穿过主骨干会「污染」图像表示，LSC 则把噪声直接短路到需要的位置，从而让主骨干保留更干净的特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 若 LVR 采用扩散骨干生成或维护 latent 推理状态，该文关于「主骨干内图像信号被噪声污染、部分信息应由旁路承载」的诊断，可能为内部状态中视觉证据的保存与旁路设计提供可核查线索，迁移链条尚属推测。
